name: Elopteryx
isnote: PBDB places it in Alvarezsauridae; recent work treats it as a paravian (Kessler et al. 2005; Mayr et al. 2019) and suggests that Balaur may be its junior synonym.
sum: Paravian from the Maastrichtian of Hațeg, Romania, long known only from fragmentary leg bones.
holotype: BMNH A1234, a proximal left femur, Sânpetru Formation, Hațeg Basin, Romania.
material: A second femur fragment (BMNH A1235), a tibiotarsus (BMNH A4359) once given the holotype number, and new specimens reported in the 21st century.
biology: Lived on the Late Cretaceous Hațeg Island; whether Balaur bondoc belongs here is debated.
author: Andrews 1913

sources.text: C. W. Andrews. 1913. On some bird remains from the Upper Cretaceous of Transslyvania. Geological Magazine, new series, decade 5 10(5):193-196
